ByteDanceTextToVideoNode/seedance-1-0-pr.label: Seedance 1.0 Pro Fast

constraints.note: Seedance 1.0 Pro Fast makes silent video. Only Seedance 1.5 Pro adds sound.

price.note: 211 credits per million tokens, exactly $1.00. Billed by tokens. tokens = (duration x 24 + 1) x width x height / 1024, where width and height are the pixel size BytePlus renders for the chosen tier and ratio (480p 16:9 is 864x480 on the 1.0 series, 864x496 on 1.5 Pro). The token count includes one trailing frame: a 4 s 480p clip is 97 x 864 x 480 / 1024 = 39285 tokens.

ByteDanceTextToVideoNode/seedance-1-0-pr.notes: BytePlus documents 2 to 12 s; the node's slider starts at 3, so 3 to 12 is what we can send. Node is narrower and wins. The node folds resolution, ratio, duration, seed, camerafixed and watermark into the prompt as --flags, so a user prompt must not contain those words as flags or the node raises (raise_if_text_params). BytePlus also offers a frames parameter for fractional durations on the 1.0 series; the node does not expose it.

WanTextToImageApi/wan2.5-t2i-preview.strengths: One flat price at every size, 6.33 credits, Chinese and English prompts
WanTextToImageApi/wan2.5-t2i-preview.notes: Only one model id, wan2.5-t2i-preview, and no size presets: width and height are free integers in 768 to 1440, step 32. Prompt up to 2000 characters, negative prompt up to 500, both auto-truncated past that. prompt_extend defaults to true and can trip content moderation on prompts naming copyrighted work; turn it off and retry when that happens. Docs versus schema: Alibaba states the total pixel area must be between 1280x1280 (1638400) and 1440x1440 (2073600), which would rule out the node's own 1024x1024 default. Recorded here as the node's range, with maxArea from the docs, because nothing above 1440x1440 is reachable anyway.
mismatches: Alibaba documents a minimum area of 1638400 px (1280x1280); the node defaults to 1024x1024. The node range is recorded.
The API's n defaults to 4 (1 to 4); ComfyUI pins it to 1. Node is narrower and wins.

WanTextToVideoApi/wan2.5-t2v-preview.label: Wan 2.5 Video (preview)

constraints.note: Wan 2.5 makes 5 and 10 second clips. A 15 second clip needs Wan 2.6.

price.note: Per second of output. A 10 s 1080p clip is 316.5 credits, about $1.50.

WanTextToVideoApi/wan2.5-t2v-preview.strengths: The lowest Wan rate, 10.55 credits a second at 480p
WanTextToVideoApi/wan2.5-t2v-preview.notes: size is one combo carrying both tier and aspect, for example '720p: 16:9 (1280x720)', and those thirteen strings match Alibaba's documented resolution list exactly. generate_audio makes the model dub the clip itself; the optional AUDIO input (3 to 29 s) drives lip sync and is not something a text-only request supplies. Prompt up to 1500 characters, negative prompt up to 500.
mismatches: The node's duration INT is 5 to 15 step 5, which offers 15 s for this model; ComfyUI raises on 15 s. Effective set is 5 and 10.
Alibaba documents a shot_type parameter for wan2.6 models only; the node offers it for both ids on this node.

WanTextToVideoApi/wan2.6-t2v.notes: shot_type single or multi asks for one continuous shot or several with cuts, and only takes effect when prompt_extend is true. generate_audio dubs the clip. Alibaba allows any integer 2 to 15 s; the node's slider is 5, 10 or 15, so the node is narrower and wins.

Wan2TextToVideoApi/wan2.7-t2v.notes: This node uses Alibaba's newer protocol: resolution and ratio are separate fields rather than one size string, and the output pixel size follows from the pair (720P 16:9 is 1280x720, 1080P 16:9 is 1920x1080). There is no audio on/off switch: Alibaba's parameter table lists resolution, ratio, duration, prompt_extend, watermark and seed only, and the node's tooltip says the model generates matching background music or sound effects when no audio_url is supplied, so treat the clip as having sound. The optional AUDIO input (1.5 to 60 s in the node, 2 to 30 s in the docs) drives lip sync and is not part of a text-only request. Prompt up to 5000 characters, negative prompt up to 500.
mismatches: The node validates a connected audio clip at 1.5 to 60 s; Alibaba documents 2 to 30 s for audio_url. The node is wider here, but the input is optional and out of scope for text to video.
Neither the docs nor the node expose an audio on/off switch for wan2.7-t2v, so 'audio: true' is inferred from the node tooltip and the automatic dubbing example, not from a parameter.
